outcome: Diagnostic performance (sensitivity) for vaginal carriage of group B streptococci
cohort: The study included vaginal swab samples taken intrapartum from a randomly selected cohort of 902 pregnant women giving birth at a single childbirth and maternity unit.
finding: Both BD MAX and GenomEra PCR assays performed comparably to culture for intrapartum detection of vaginal carriage of group B streptococci, with GenomEra being a potentially easy and rapid on-site test.
